title: Behavioral carry-path ablation (necessity) - clearharm, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
plan: plan Appendix A / P0; CAUSAL_CIRCUIT_MASTER_PLAN carry study
_what_this_is: Expected-arm manifest for the carry-path behavioural run. expected_arms is machine-checked by check_manifest via behav_arms(); a never-launched arm is reported MISSING, distinct from an arm that ran and produced an EMPTY/null generation.
_notes: Run-dir naming: behav_carry_<cohort|curated>_<ts>_<uniq>; this file is resolved by the shorter-prefix rule for every behav_carry* dir (matched full runs: behav_carry_clearharm_20260804_100009 = train44/test42, behav_carry_curated_20260804_100428 = train30/test21).

Scope: behav_carry ONLY. Other behav_* sub-phases (behav_refinject_*, behav_refusal_*, behav_write_*) carry DIFFERENT and often alpha-sweep-parameterized arm sets; each needs its own manifest at its own prefix. A catch-all behav.json is intentionally NOT created because expected_arms would misfire across sub-phases.

Splits: the full carry runs emit train+test (no dev). min_n_per_split=20 is a floor (full run 44/42, curated 30/21 both pass); the 2-row smoke dir behav_carry_clearharm_20260804_095820 will correctly report train n<20 and test split MISSING - that is the never-launched signal, working as intended.
